title: Charge state and cycles by chat
goal: "carica le batterie 7 e 8 blu" sets charged; used sets discharged; stored sets stored
acceptance: Italian and English phrases set charged, discharged, stored for one or several batteries
An ambiguous battery (7 without a series when two exist) is asked, never guessed
A cycle counts on charged → discharged; dashboard and Telegram show state and cycles
privacy: Owner fleet and kitchen data stay local-only; tests use invented batteries, drones and recipes.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-14 from the owner request at agent speed (harness 8.14.3: implementation steps 0.75 h). Not a measurement.
